description.value:
Your connection to the moon shifts each night, changing in much the same way that the moon’s visage does, but at a faster pace. This connection cycles between two phases; New Moon and Full Moon. These phases manifest visually as an uncanny specular sheen to your fur. While in Full Moon phase, your fur has a faint front-lighting regardless of the light source. Meanwhile, in New Moon phase, an underglow surrounds your face and body.
You start in the New Moon phase, and each long rest you swap to the phase you aren’t currently in. Your other magical gifts as a lunar zhier are heavily influenced by which phase you are in when you use them.
